tools.name: meom-public-list-services
tools.description: Lists the services MEOM (a Finnish B2B website agency) offers, as published on meom.fi: id, name, page URL, a short summary, section headings, how the service is delivered (process text and steps) and the questions answered in the page FAQ. Pass a service id to get that service with its FAQ answers. Prices are not included; the page URL has the full description.

lang.description: Content language: "fi" (Finnish, default) or "en" (English). Not every page has an English version.

service.description: Optional service id from this list, e.g. "wordpress". Returns only that service, with FAQ answers.

tools.name: meom-public-list-references
tools.description: Lists published client references (case studies) from meom.fi, newest first: client, page URL, summary, measured results as stated on the page (empty when the page states none), the page's own text about the client and about the project, what MEOM did, platform, industries (only when the reference is tagged with one; often empty) and tags. Client size is not available. Optionally filter by a search term, a tag such as "WordPress" or "HubSpot", or only references with results.

lang.description: Content language: "fi" (Finnish, default) or "en" (English). Not every page has an English version.

query.description: Optional search term matched against reference titles and text.

has_results.description: When true, only references that state measured results.

tools.name: meom-public-list-experts
tools.description: Lists the MEOM team as shown on the meom.fi About page: name, job title, short bio and photo URL. Bios are in Finnish. Contact details are not included; use get-booking-link to get in touch.

lang.description: Content language: "fi" (Finnish, default) or "en" (English). Not every page has an English version.

tools.name: meom-public-list-proof-points
tools.description: Returns facts about MEOM as stated on meom.fi, each with the page URL it comes from and the date it was checked: company facts (founded, team, experience, specialisation), client satisfaction, service commitments, credentials and published client results. Figures that the site states inconsistently on different pages are left out. Prices are not included.

tools.name: meom-public-get-booking-link
tools.description: Returns the link where a person can book a meeting with MEOM (HubSpot Meetings), the contact page URL and the sales email address. This tool does not book anything or send any data; the person opens the link themselves. Optionally pass a service id from list-services to get that service's own booking link, if it has one.

lang.description: Content language: "fi" (Finnish, default) or "en" (English). Not every page has an English version.

service.description: Optional service id from list-services, e.g. "geo-optimointi-verkkosivustoille".
